derivation.initial_whole_owner_lift: Scale the complete donor I packing by 3 and replace each scaled I owner by the canonical inscribed truncated I in the same frame.
derivation.source_frames: Every stored donor quaternion is retained exactly; no orientations are varied.
derivation.continuation_operation: At the current complete proposed packing, switch a pair to a fixed-frame face or edge-cross separator only if that separator has strictly more slack. Restore all pairs and all host walls together with unchanged owner orientations. Intermediate decimal LP states are proposals; the final native arrangement is independently certified.
derivation.physical_return: Continue all retained contact separators after removing the source vertices, and solve one common set of32 host walls for all whole owners.
derivation.decoder: For each source quaternion q_i and listed returned center c_i, output[c_i*(10000001/10000000),q_i]. All listed decimals are finite binary64 inputs checked as exact rationals.
